name: pypi-setup-entry-points
note: a CLI package declaring a console_scripts entry point — a declaration, not install-time execution. entry_points is data passed to setup(); nothing runs during install. Must stay safe.

sourceFiles.setup.py:
from setuptools import setup, find_packages

setup(
    name="clitool",
    version="1.5.0",
    packages=find_packages(),
    entry_points={"console_scripts": ["clitool=clitool.cli:main"]},
    install_requires=["click>=8"],
)
